concepts.content: When the real exchange rate rises, domestic goods become more expensive relative to foreign goods, causing exports to fall and imports to rise, so net exports decline.

source_grounding.validation_scope: exact quotation, chunk membership and field coverage only

evidence.quote:
What happens when
 the real exchange rate goes up?
It makes our goods more expensive relative to foreign goods.

First, our exports will tend to decline because our goods are more expensive,
 and also our imports are going to tend to increase because foreign goods are cheaper,
 And so that's the reason this is decreasing with respect to the exchange rate.
